summary: Searches the global module doubly-linked list for the node whose data pointer equals a1, unlinks it, updates head/tail globals, decrements the pool counter, and frees both the node and (if the node flag byte at +12 is set) its owned data object. Also calls a vtable method on the a1 sub-object retrieved via FieldGetter_5cc0 and runs EmptyStub_0170. Returns 0 on successful removal, 1 on empty list or not-found.

operations.description: Retrieve the sub-object of *a1 via FieldGetter_5cc0 and call its vtable method at offset 4 on the result.
Read the global list head dword_8D3BFC into the walk pointer v2.
Return 1 when the list head dword_8D3BFC is null (empty list).
Walk the list via next pointers v2[1] comparing each node's data pointer *v2 with a1; return 1 if the scan exhausts without a match.
If the matched node equals the tail dword_8D3C04, advance that tail to the node's successor v2[1].
Unlink the node from its predecessor: set prev-of-successor v2[1] to the node's predecessor v2[2], or update head dword_8D3BFC when there is no predecessor.
Unlink the node from its successor: set next-of-predecessor v2[2] to the node's successor v2[1], or update tail dword_8D3C00 when the node was the tail.
Decrement the pool allocation counter dword_8D3C08.
When the node's flag byte at +12 is set and its data pointer *v2 is non-null, destroy the data object via VTableDestructorThenNullPointer and free it.
Free the node (and its owned data object when owned) via FreeWrapper_7bcf.
Return 0 on successful removal, 1 on empty list or not-found.

clean_pseudocode: while (*v2 != a1) { v2 = v2[1]; if (!v2) return 1; }
